speaker.arrivalBody:
The Congress Center Hamburg sits at Dammtor, right in the city.
By train: long-distance services stop at Hamburg Dammtor, a five-minute walk away.
By car: there is a car park at the CCH, the approach is signposted. Allow extra time at rush hour.
On site: the speaker counter in the foyer is your first stop.

The speaker team then reviews it, and you get an email once it is decided. A released claim cannot be changed, so read it through once more before you send it. We produce the expense invoice ourselves — you do not need to write one.

steps.title: Complete your profile
steps.body: Go to the exhibitor area of the app and fill in your profile completely. Add links to your careers page and social channels, a header image and further information.

steps.title: Add your team
steps.body: Best through the partner portal under “Contacts”. You can also add team members directly in the app — but only once they have personalised a ticket to their email address.

steps.title: Complete your colleagues’ profiles
steps.body: Ideally every team member’s profile is filled in properly, so participants can see straight away who they are talking to.

steps.body: Important: in each profile, make sure contacts are shared with the team. Otherwise you will not be able to access your leads afterwards. The wiki explains how.

steps.title: Post open roles
steps.body: Under “Open roles” you can add positions. We recommend at most three, and ones that are appealing and representative. A traineeship or a project manager role speaks to a broad audience — very specific roles put people off at first.

steps.title: Find matching profiles
steps.body: The app goes live in mid-March. Under “Participants” you can then filter profiles by various criteria, among them field of study and work experience. Use it to identify suitable talent and reach out with a pointer to your presence. More tips are in the wiki under Event app.

deleteProfile.title: Delete profile
deleteProfile.lead: Your right under Art. 17 GDPR. Here is exactly what happens.
deleteProfile.whatAnonymised: Your name, date of birth, contact details, CV and your answers about interests and background are deleted.
deleteProfile.whatKept: What remains without you: bookings, orders and registrations stay as figures — without your name and with no link to you. We need them for accounting and retention periods, and afterwards they cannot be traced to anyone.
deleteProfile.whatSuppression: Your e-mail address goes onto our suppression list as an irreversible checksum. We no longer store the address itself; the checksum makes sure no mail from us ever reaches you again — not even if someone enters you afresh later.
deleteProfile.whatAccess: Your access ends immediately. You cannot sign in afterwards, and we cannot restore your profile.
deleteProfile.whatAudit: We record that a deletion took place today — without your name. That is the proof that we acted on your right.
deleteProfile.blockersLead: Something is still attached to your profile that concerns other people. So someone from the team looks at it instead of deleting right away — you will get an answer.
deleteProfile.fieldReasonHint: Helps us do better. You don't have to give one.
deleteProfile.confirmDeleteBody: This cannot be undone. Your access ends immediately and we cannot restore your profile.
deleteProfile.confirmRequestBody: Your profile stays for now. Someone from the team will look at the request and get back to you.
deleteProfile.doneBody: Name, contact details, CV and your answers are gone, and your access has ended. What remains is bookings, orders and registrations as figures with no personal reference — for accounting and retention periods — plus a note that a deletion happened today, without your name.
deleteProfile.doneSuppression: Your address is on the suppression list as a checksum. That is not a remnant of your data but the mechanism that protects you from further mail — we no longer hold the address itself.
deleteProfile.pendingTitle: Your request is with the team
deleteProfile.pendingBody: Until someone has looked at it, your profile stays unchanged and your access remains. You will get an answer by mail.
